description:
When Otto opens a PR for an implement_issue task, the current body is just `Closes #N`. Enrich it with a structured PR description produced directly by the configured agent runner.

The runner already has the issue title/body, hydrated context, repo checkout, and public-output instructions. Extend the structured runner output schema to accept an optional markdown `prBody` field alongside `summary` and `commentSummaries`. The `prBody` should contain sections like:

- What was done (2-4 sentences)
- Key changes (bullet list of files/approach)
- Testing notes (if any)
- Closes #N (always last)

This keeps Otto agent-agnostic: Claude, Codex, or a custom command runner can provide the PR body without Otto making a second model/API call. If `prBody` is missing, blank, or unusable, Otto must fall back to the plain `Closes #N` body.

Implementation notes:
- Add optional `prBody` to `AgentRunResult` and the structured output parser.
- Update runner prompt instructions to request `prBody` for issue-comment tasks that will open PRs.
- Update `createPrForIssueTask` in `src/github/pulls.ts` to accept optional `agentPrBody` and ensure the closing issue link remains `Closes #N` as the final line.
- Pass `result.prBody` from `executeRun` when creating PRs for issue-comment sources.
- Cover parser and PR creation fallback behavior in tests.
title: AI-generated PR body summarizing agent work
